correctness.rationale: For capacity-one 3x5 nonattacking rook placements, rotation by one of five columns acts freely on every nonempty face: each row contains at most one rook and no nontrivial column rotation fixes a cell. Source has 15/60/60 cells and quotient has 3/12/12 vertex/edge/triangle orbits. With maximal tree edges a1,b1 collapsed, each of 12 triangle attaching words equals a_i c_{j-i} b_j^{-1}. Nine elementary free-group generator/two-cell cancellations leave attaching words t^5, t^{-5}, and empty, and a standard two-cell slide changes these to degree-five and two null 2-cells, giving M(Z/5,1) wedge S2 wedge S2. The quotient has fundamental group Z/5 and H2=Z². As it is the universal regular C5-cover, the standard chain R -N-> R -(g-1)-> R of degree-five Moore space has ker N=augmentation ideal I_C5; the two lifted 2-spheres supply R², giving rank4+10=14. Independently enumerated all quotient simplex orbits and computed abelianized quotient boundary Smith factor 5 plus H2 rank 2; inspected exact nonabelian reduction and source verification code for nine free-group eliminations.
